description: This file defines the interface for a GStreamer wrapper (IGstWrapper) and its factory (IGstWrapperFactory) within the Rialto media server component. It includes method declarations for initializing GStreamer, managing plugins, creating and manipulating GStreamer elements, pads, buffers, and messages, as well as handling caps, events, and stream volume. The file serves as an abstraction layer to interact with GStreamer in a platform-agnostic way.
